name: Disappearance of crime and violence
definition: Murder, crime and violence vanish from a society through upbringing, breeding or social change.

name: End of poverty and material want
definition: A condition in which poverty, hunger and material want have been abolished for the population of a country or the world, through abundance, machines or social reform.

name: Abolition of private property
definition: Private ownership of productive property and inherited wealth is abolished and society is reorganized under communal or socialist ownership.

name: Prohibition of alcohol
definition: A national or widespread legal ban on making and selling alcoholic drink.

name: Alien conquest or rule of Earth
definition: Extraterrestrials conquer, dominate or govern humanity.

name: Society without government
definition: A community that has no government or state and settles disputes by itself, or the claim that such anarchy cannot work.

name: Anglo-American union or alliance
definition: A formal political alliance or federation joining Britain and the United States (or the English-speaking nations) with a shared president, policy or war aims.

name: Armed insurrection in a great Western city
definition: Revolutionaries or mobs with weapons and bombs storm public buildings and fight in the streets of a major city such as London or New York.

name: War between Asian powers and the West
definition: An Asian power or alliance, such as China or Japan, invades and conquers or subjugates Europe, America or the white nations.

name: Public backlash against controversial biotechnology
definition: A religious or political movement that fears, bans or suppresses a new medical technology such as reanimation, rejuvenation or artificial life.

name: Reorganization of the Balkans
definition: The end of Turkish rule in Europe and the making of new Balkan states, such as a single Slav republic, a Macedonian kingdom or protectorates.

name: Breakup of a nation into civil wars
definition: A state or empire splits into rival regions or successor states, by secession, declared independence or civil war.

name: Britain becomes a republic
definition: The British monarchy is overthrown or abolished and Britain becomes a republic with an elected president or council.

name: Calendar or clock reform
definition: Adoption of a single reformed calendar or standard clock system, such as a fixed weekday calendar or a 24-hour clock.

name: Caste or class society assigned by the state
definition: Society is divided into hereditary or state-assigned castes or classes with fixed rank, role and rights.

name: Centralized national bureaucracy
definition: A national government organized into regions and agencies that administers citizens through many offices and vast bureaucracy.

name: China as dominant world power
definition: China or an East Asian empire becomes the leading military and economic power of Asia and challenges or overtakes the West.

name: Official rating of citizens by aptitude or mental class
definition: The state tests and registers each person's intelligence, aptitude or mental class and uses the rating to allocate roles and impose controls.

name: Mass civilian evacuation and air-raid panic
definition: Large numbers of civilians flee or are evacuated from cities threatened by attack, with public panic and political change driven by fear of bombing.

name: East-West Cold War
definition: A prolonged hostile standoff between a Soviet-led Communist bloc and the United States and its allies, short of open general war, with rival blocs, espionage and arms build-up.

name: Exploitation of native peoples of other worlds
definition: Colonists or Earth powers who exploit, enslave or demand tribute from the native inhabitants of other planets.

name: Isolated colonies regress to primitive society
definition: Colony worlds cut off from the rest of civilization lose their technology and knowledge and fall back to a primitive way of life.

name: Colony wins independence from Earth
definition: Settlers or natives on a colony planet or moon rise against rule by Earth or a colonial power and win self-government.

name: Communal or institutional child care
definition: Children are raised and educated in groups by specialists, nurseries or state institutions rather than by parents at home, with the family no longer the unit of child care.

name: Public eating places replace home cooking
definition: Households stop cooking at home and eat in public or cooperative dining halls and kitchens.

name: Accepted public nudity
definition: Going without clothing in public or in shared spaces is normal in a society or crew.

name: Communist expansion toward world rule
definition: Communist states or movements spread across the world, with the aim or result of dominating it.

name: Compulsory state exercise regime
definition: A state requirement of daily physical exercise and public drill for every citizen.

name: Confederate victory in the Civil War
definition: The Southern Confederacy wins the American Civil War and survives as an independent nation beside a reduced United States.

name: Conquest or defeat of a major Western power
definition: A foreign power defeats and occupies, partitions or rules the United States or Britain, which loses territory, empire or sovereignty.
bundle_check: ok (US and Britain are one pattern: conquest of a leading Western power)

name: Corporations controlling government
definition: Large corporations, lobbies or a single company effectively govern a country, planet or population, controlling policy, war and colonies.

name: Coup d etat
definition: A faction, official or general seizes the government or throne by force, assassination or deceit.

name: Democracy eroding into despotism
definition: A democratic country loses real parliamentary power as central administration, demagogues or a ruler take control and liberty wears away into dictatorship.
bundle_check: note: gradual administrative erosion versus abrupt strongman takeover

name: Decline of religious faith and church wealth
definition: Religious belief and observance fade in a society, and churches lose wealth, status and state role, until religion is marginal or gone.

name: End of European rule in Africa
definition: The withdrawal of European colonial powers from African territories as local peoples take over their own government.

name: Diplomacy and treaties with aliens
definition: Humans and alien civilizations exchange ambassadors or embassies and conduct treaties and trade.

name: Direct democracy by frequent popular vote
definition: A system in which citizens vote directly on laws and public matters many times a year, or laws are published for worldwide criticism before they pass.

name: Dissent treated as mental illness
definition: A regime treats dissent, crime or unhappiness as sickness or insanity to be diagnosed, confined and treated.

name: Division of Germany into separate states
definition: Germany is split into separate states or occupation zones after a war.

name: Formal duelling revived
definition: The law or custom recognizes duels, licensed assassins or political killing as lawful ways to settle disputes.
bundle_check: note: formal dueling versus guild assassination could differ in date

name: Earth administration of colonies on other worlds
definition: A government on Earth that rules planetary colonies through commissioners, councils or an Earth commission.

name: Emancipation of slaves
definition: A law or decree ending legal slavery in a country, followed by the gradual and contested social status of freed people.

name: Restrictions on emigration
definition: Laws or quotas by which a state forbids or caps emigration of citizens or immigration of foreigners.

name: Mass emigration from overcrowded Earth
definition: Population pressure drives large numbers of people to leave Earth for other planets or stars.

name: End of nations and national identity
definition: National governments and national character dissolve into a unified, cosmopolitan world society.

name: Change and standardization of the English language
definition: The future drift of English into a changed or clipped form, or a deliberate effort to standardize its pronunciation and teaching.

name: English as the world language
definition: English becomes the common language used for world affairs and by most of humanity.

name: European political union
definition: A union of European states with common borders, laws, trade and citizenship, replacing separate national barriers, for example a Central European federation.

name: Common threat unites the nations
definition: A real or apparent outside danger, such as an alien invasion or catastrophe, that ends rivalry among Earth powers and produces lasting international cooperation.

name: Mass famine from war or breakdown of supply
definition: A famine kills or displaces millions in a country or region through failed food supply, after war, blockade, bombing or breakdown of trade and crops.

name: Rise of a fascist dictatorship
definition: A dictator and a party with paramilitary militias that seize a European state and militarize the nation.

name: Firearms ban or registration
definition: A law bans, registers or controls private weapons.

name: Fixed-term marriage contract
definition: Marriage is a contract for a set term, renewable, with divorce terms agreed in advance and free divorce.

name: Free partner choice and loosened marriage
definition: Society drops rigid sexual and marriage codes and accepts free partner choice, trial marriage, casual, commercial and non-conventional relationships.

name: General disarmament
definition: Nations or a whole planet reduce or give up their armaments by agreement, by law or under popular pressure.

name: German power in Europe
definition: Germany becoming the leading or dominant power in Europe, or a great Germanic union of nations.

name: Reunification of Germany
definition: Separate German states are reunified into one nation.

name: Collapse of global civilization
definition: A sudden or gradual breakdown of industrial society after war, catastrophe or decay that destroys governments, commerce and cities, leaving gangs, scavenging and famine.

name: Global nuclear war
definition: A war in which nuclear weapons are used in quantity on cities, killing most of a country's or the world's population and wrecking civilization.

name: Government-fabricated war or threat
definition: A government or conspirators stage a war, invasion scare or crisis to unite the public or seize power.

name: Hereditary monarchy persisting into the future
definition: A royal dynasty that continues to rule a nation, such as the Hohenzollerns, far into the future.

name: Extinction of the human race
definition: Humanity dies out or is reduced to a few last survivors, through war, plague, infertility, conquest or decline.

name: Institutional human sacrifice
definition: A society or priesthood carries out human sacrifice as ritual or tax.

name: Humans kept as food or livestock
definition: Humans are farmed, fed on or processed as livestock by aliens or by a descendant species.

name: Individualized and hands-on schooling
definition: Schooling is reformed to fit each child's aptitudes, with experiment and entertainment in place of textbooks and fixed grades.

name: Travel permits and internal passports
definition: People need passes, identity tags or permits to move within or between places, and movement and exit are policed.

name: International court and war-crimes trials
definition: A standing international court or tribunal that judges disputes between states or tries leaders for war crimes and crimes against humanity.

name: Large-scale international drug trade
definition: An illegal trade in narcotics running across borders or between planets, run by criminal syndicates.

name: International organization to prevent war
definition: A permanent international organization of states, such as a league or United Nations with an assembly and council, that arbitrates disputes and tries to keep peace among nations.

name: Interplanetary law, customs and travel regulation
definition: A legal order between worlds with customs inspection, courts, visas, manifests and clearance rules that regulate who and what may travel or trade between planets.

name: War between planets
definition: A war between Earth and another inhabited planet, or between planetary governments, fought with fleets.

name: Space health authority with quarantine power
definition: An interplanetary or interstellar medical service has authority to inspect, quarantine and regulate medicine on planets.

name: Jewish state in Palestine
definition: Jews gather in Palestine and a state or national home is established there, or the movement toward it is blocked.

name: General strike and labor uprising
definition: A large strike or rising of organized workers that is crushed by troops or wins power, including strikes by robots.

name: State-sanctioned lethal sport or execution as spectacle
definition: Killing of people, as hunts, fights or public executions, is organized as legal entertainment or an institution.

name: Compulsory killing of the old or unfit
definition: The state kills or orders the death of people because of age, illness or social uselessness.

name: Martial law and curfew
definition: Military or emergency rule in a city or country that suspends civil government, imposes blackout, curfew and passes and puts troops in the streets.

name: Mass absorption in entertainment
definition: A population that withdraws from real life into screen entertainment, fantasy or private dream worlds, so that towns and work are neglected.

name: Female-ruled society
definition: A society or state in which women rule and men are subordinate in law and custom, segregated or kept as breeders.

name: Doctors holding political power
definition: The medical profession or its lobby wields special authority and power over the state.

name: Continuous urban megalopolis
definition: Cities merge into one continuous urban region of tens of millions spanning a former region or country.

name: Private mercenary armies for hire
definition: Private armies or legions are hired by governments to fight their wars.

name: Messiah and final judgment
definition: A saviour figure arrives to judge sinners and end an age of evil or restore virtue.

name: Golden age of harmony and brotherhood
definition: Humanity grows more altruistic, kind and virtuous, or enters a lasting era of goodwill and brotherhood, through education, evolution, social change or after catastrophe.

name: Nationalization of industry
definition: The state, after a revolution or by law, takes over private industries or the whole economy and runs production and labor centrally.

name: New religion or cult founded by a prophet
definition: A new religious or secular-religious movement, built around a founder or prophet, gains millions of followers within a few years.

name: New York as capital of the world
definition: New York becoming the seat of world government or the center of world affairs, a giant world city.

name: Political union of North America
definition: The United States, Canada and Mexico merge or form one continental government with a single president.

name: Race to the North Pole and claim to it
definition: An expedition or public contest to reach the North Pole, with prize money, fame and claims of ownership or settlement of the Arctic.

name: Official rewriting of history
definition: Authorities alter or erase records and accounts of past events to fit the regime's story.

name: Powerful organized crime gangs
definition: Large criminal organizations operate openly, control a city or underworld and may take over territory and replace government, mostly escaping punishment.

name: Overthrow of the Russian Tsar
definition: The Tsar is deposed or captured by revolution and the imperial regime ends.

name: African political unification
definition: A leader or movement unites African peoples or states under one federation or rule.

name: Union of Islamic or Arab states, or revived caliphate
definition: A political union of Muslim or Arab states, or a caliphate proclaimed under a single ruler across a region.
bundle_check: note: Arab or Islamic state union versus proclaimed caliphate may differ in date

name: Pope or religious council as world arbiter
definition: The Pope or a council of religious leaders is accepted by the great powers as arbiter of international disputes or as ruler of the world.

name: Permanent end of war between nations
definition: War between nations ends for good or becomes obsolete, through treaty, changed attitudes, conditioning or institutions, so no major interstate war occurs for generations.

name: Purpose-built capital city
definition: A new capital city is planned and built from scratch to seat a national or world government.

name: Polygamy from a shortage of men
definition: A custom or law of one man having several wives (or the reverse) adopted to cope with an imbalance in the numbers of the sexes.

name: The papacy removed from Rome
definition: The Pope leaves or is driven from Rome and the papacy is relocated elsewhere, such as America, or Rome is destroyed.

name: Post-collapse tribal or feudal society
definition: A society after the collapse of industrial civilization that has reverted to tribes, nomads, bandits or medieval feudal lords, with swords and horses in place of machines.

name: Leisure society without need for work
definition: Machines and abundance make work minimal or unnecessary so that the population lives in leisure.

name: Press censorship and news suppression
definition: The state controls or suppresses news, publications and speech, forces newspapers to submit articles for approval and punishes forbidden expression.

name: Rehabilitative prison reform
definition: A prison system based on classification, trust, inmate councils or self-supporting prison labor that repays victims.

name: Persecution and regulation of psychics
definition: Laws or public action test, register, ban, hunt or persecute people with psychic ability as a hated minority.

name: Persecution of religious groups
definition: State or mob action that imprisons, kills or removes the rights of members of a religion, such as Catholics, pagans or Muslims, for their belief.

name: Restoration of a deposed monarch
definition: A king or queen who lost the throne is returned to power.

name: Women choose and propose to men
definition: Custom or law gives women the role of courting, choosing and proposing marriage to men.

name: Revolution overthrows a regime
definition: A popular or conspiratorial uprising that overthrows a ruling oligarchy, tyrant or monarch and installs a new government.

name: Rigged or meaningless elections
definition: Elections that are controlled by gangs or the regime through dead voters, intimidation, unanimous votes or hollow formalities.

name: Ruling order of a self-selected elite
definition: A voluntary or selected elite order, bound by a rule, governs and may alone vote or hold office.

name: Scientists confined in secret state laboratories
definition: Scientists working on strategic projects are confined to secret government facilities and barred from leaving.

name: Secret police and informer state
definition: A government that uses a secret police force, informers and night arrests to find and seize dissenters and enforce curfews and conformity.

name: Secret society seeking world control
definition: A hidden organization or brotherhood of conspirators plots to rule the world or secretly controls governments, wars and revolutions.

name: Outlaws declared shoot-on-sight
definition: A legal power by which an authority formally declares a person or ship an outlaw, permitting anyone to kill them on sight without trial.

name: Single world religion
definition: A condition in which one faith or a unified church is held by nearly the whole world, by revival, conversion or enforcement.

name: Slavery of whole populations
definition: Slavery or servile classes of enslaved people are an accepted legal institution of a society or empire, including slave trade and serfdom.

name: Social effects of long life
definition: Greatly extended life or immortality changes society, causing overcrowding, stagnation, aged politicians, murders of the old, suicide, persecution or religious opposition.

name: Solar-system-wide political union
definition: A federation, league or government of the human-settled planets and moons of the Solar System with a common council, fleet or law, ruling from a central seat.

name: Collapse of the Soviet Union
definition: The dissolution of the Soviet state into independent successor states with the freeing of eastern Europe.

name: Public and political backlash against space programs
definition: Fear, boredom or budget cuts that turn the public and legislators against space research or expensive space projects.

name: Legal claims to land and resources in space
definition: A law or treaty lets a person, company or nation claim ownership of a planet, asteroid mineral deposit or lunar territory.

name: Arms control over orbital weapons
definition: Negotiations or fears around weapons platforms in orbit, with superpower prestige politics and calls for disarmament in space.

name: Stagnant, conformist society
definition: A society that has solved its problems or enforces uniformity loses ambition, independent thought and progress, so life is static, uniform and decadent, with deviation penalized.
bundle_check: note: stagnation from success versus enforced conformity

name: State-enforced limits on births
definition: A government caps family size or total population by law, licensing, incentive or sterilization.

name: Compulsory or make-work employment
definition: A state that guarantees or forces jobs for all, including pointless make-work, work cards and compulsory labor for wages.

name: State schedule of daily life
definition: The state prescribes hours of sleep, meals, work and private activities for citizens, enforced by controllers.

name: Space race between rival powers
definition: Two rival powers compete to reach the Moon first and to claim space, often under military direction.

name: Suppression of science and technology
definition: Authorities, a cult or priesthood ban, punish or suppress scientific study, machinery, inventions or particular technologies judged dangerous.

name: Survivors repopulate the Earth
definition: After a catastrophe a small remnant of humanity, often one couple, survives and starts a new human population and civilization.

name: Rule by scientists or experts
definition: Government is run by scientists, engineers or trained experts rather than elected politicians.

name: Telepaths used by police
definition: Police, governments or intelligence services use telepaths or psychics for interrogation, intelligence and security.

name: Theocratic state
definition: A government run by religious authorities enforces belief and religious law.

name: Authorities regulating time travel
definition: Police or governments regulate time travel and remove travelers who alter the timeline.

name: Total war
definition: A war in which the whole state and citizenry are mobilized and civilians are not spared.

name: Totalitarian dictatorship over a nation
definition: A regime in which one party or ruler controls all aspects of life, subordinating the individual to the state through force, ideology, regimentation, mass imprisonment, torture and execution of opponents.

name: Universal compulsory public education
definition: All children are by law schooled in public schools, with libraries open to all and child labor banned.

name: Universal military service
definition: Every man of a given age is required by law to serve in the armed forces, including conscription of civilians and prisoners.

name: US expansion over neighboring lands
definition: The United States takes in territory beyond its borders, such as Canada, Mexico, Central America, Pacific islands or Alaska, by annexation or statehood.

name: US-Soviet cooperation
definition: The United States and the Soviet Union or Russia cooperate in joint projects or crisis control, including in space.

name: Vegetarian society
definition: A society or world stops eating meat and killing animals, regarding meat as repugnant, savage or unethical.

name: Reparations and hardship imposed on Germany
definition: Peace terms after a war that impose payments on Germany under outside control, predicted to cause starvation and loss of independence.

name: Voluntary return to simple pre-industrial life
definition: A population or society that deliberately gives up machines and cities and returns to farming or pastoral living in the countryside.

name: Woman as head of state or government
definition: A woman serves as president, prime minister or monarch of a country.

name: Women in all occupations and war work
definition: Women work in all trades, replace drafted men in industry in wartime and serve alongside men in the military and public life.

name: Votes and office for women
definition: A law or settled norm gives women equal civil and political rights, including the vote and seats in a national parliament, committees or cabinet.

name: Workers' uprising against capitalists
definition: A violent uprising of workers or a revolutionary movement against capitalist rulers and property owners.

name: World government
definition: A single government or federation, with a president, congress or council, that holds authority over all or nearly all nations of Earth and replaces or overrides national governments.

name: Dictator ruling the world or a planet
definition: One ruler or would-be ruler, through conquest, weapons or conspiracy, holds or seeks absolute personal power over the whole Earth, the Solar System or a planet.
bundle_check: ok (holding versus seeking world rule are one story pattern)

name: Global or international police force
definition: A permanent armed police or peacekeeping force controlled by a world body that operates in many countries to enforce order and suppress conflicts in place of local forces.
aliases: federal police under a global body

name: World population reaches billions
definition: The population of the Earth or a continent grows to a stated figure of billions, mostly through doubling within a lifetime.

name: World war between great powers
definition: A war involving most of the great powers of the world, fought with modern fleets and aircraft across several continents.
